title: 第9658章 她怎么敢的呀第9657章 如有反抗
content_zh:
原本还镇定自若的冉少燕见到陈飞婌竟然如此的果决，直接命令出手，神情顿时急了!
但她急得不是自己，也不是陈飞婌，而是急得陈飞婌这个不知天高地厚的小丫头片子竟然敢向叶阁下出手?
哗哗哗!
正厅内劲风扑面，一下子好像长江大河般炸开!
灵墨轩目光一冷，鼓荡修为，直接就要出手!
可是下一刹，诡异的一幕发生了!
灵墨轩发现来袭的这十几个生灵全都莫名其妙的凝滞在了虚空之中!
与此同时，耳边传来了冉少燕带着紧张和请求的声音!
“叶阁下，请手下留情!”
灵墨轩自然明白是叶无缺出手了。
只见冲向叶无缺的那一批人，在距离叶无缺三尺外的虚空全都凝固!
他们眼中带着深深的惊骇与不可思议，感觉到自己如同被无形大手给原地抓住，连挣扎一下的资格都没有。
紧跟着，这十数道身影以比冲进来快出两倍的速度横飞了出去，砸向了庄园的各个角落，狼狈不堪。
原本带着笑意的陈飞婌一下子就傻眼了!
但满地打滚的手下们提醒她这一切都是真的!
“这不可能!!”
“谁干的?”
陈飞婌一下子急了，原本明明一切尽在掌控，怎么会突变成这样?
但陈飞婌眼力也是不凡，再结合冉少燕方才的大声呼喊，她一下子就盯住了正厅内端坐着的叶无缺!
“是你!?”

陈飞婌死死盯着叶无缺，然后……
不是恐惧!
不是紧张!
不是忌惮万分!
竟然是……
“你好大的胆子!”
“竟敢打我的人!!你完了!!”
“我一定要你付出代价!!”
“我要你求生不得求死不能!!”
这陈飞婌暴跳如雷，喝骂出声，手指头都指向了叶无缺。
这一下子，所有人都惊呆了!
冉少燕，风姿绰约的脸庞都几乎呆住了。
而正厅内另一边的灵墨轩更是眼神都愣住了!
“灵爷爷，这个什么陈飞婌，她这么的……没脑子吗?”
“她看不出来叶阁下的强大和厉害早已超乎了她的想象，一根手指头就能蹍死她吗?”
“她还敢出言不逊辱骂叶阁下?”
content_en:
Ran Shaoyan, who was originally calm and composed, suddenly became anxious when she saw that Chen Feinao was so decisive and directly ordered to take action!
But she was so anxious, not for herself, nor for Chen Feinai, but for Chen Feinao, a little girl who didn't know the heights of the world, to dare to take action against Mr. Ye?
Wow wow wow!
There was a strong wind in the main hall, and it suddenly exploded like the Yangtze River!
Lingmo Xuan's eyes turned cold, and he was ready to take action immediately!
But the next moment, a strange scene happened!
Lingmoxuan found that the dozen or so creatures that were attacking were all inexplicably stagnant in the void!
At the same time, Ran Shaoyan's nervous and pleading voice came to his ears!
"Your Excellency Ye, please show mercy!"
Lingmoxuan naturally understood that it was Ye Wuque who took action.
I saw the group of people rushing towards Ye Wuque, all solidifying in the void three feet away from Ye Wuque!
There was deep horror and disbelief in their eyes, and they felt as if they were being held in place by invisible hands, without even the qualification to struggle.
Immediately afterwards, these dozen figures flew out at twice the speed as they rushed in, smashing into every corner of the manor, making a mess.
Chen Feinai, who was originally smiling, was suddenly dumbfounded!
But the men rolling on the ground reminded her that all this was true!
"This is impossible!!"
"Who did it?"
Chen Feinao suddenly became anxious. Originally, everything was clearly under control, so how could it suddenly become like this?
But Chen Feinai's eyesight is also extraordinary. Combined with Ran Shaoyan's loud shout just now, she immediately stared at Ye Wuque who was sitting in the main hall!
"It's you!?"
Chen Feinao stared at Ye Wuque, and then...
Not fear!
Not nervous!
It’s not that I’m extremely afraid!
It turned out to be...
"You are so brave!"
"How dare you hit my people!! You are finished!!"
"I must make you pay the price!!"
"I want you to live but not to die!!"
Chen Feinao was furious, yelled and cursed, and pointed his fingers at Ye Wuque.
At this moment, everyone was stunned!
Ran Shaoyan's graceful face was almost stunned.
On the other side of the main hall, Ling Moxuan's eyes were stunned!
"Grandpa Ling, what is this Chen Feinao? Is she so... brainless?"
"Can't she see that Lord Ye's power and power have already exceeded her imagination? Can he kill her with just one finger?"
"She still dares to speak rudely and insult Mr. Ye?"
